info.title: DevQuest API
info.description: JWT API for React. All journey endpoints require authentication. Admin endpoints require role admin. Keys use snake_case, UUID strings and ISO 8601 UTC timestamps. First release supports multiple choice.

put.description: Supply every sibling ID, including drafts, in the desired order. Positions become 1..N atomically. Frozen paths return 409; incomplete/foreign sets return 422.

CreateLearningPath.description: Admin only. Multiple-choice exercises require >=2 options with exactly one correct. Code exercises can only be drafts.

UpdateLearningPath.description: Partial update. Parent identifiers are immutable. Structural edits return 409 after any student starts the path. Supplying options replaces the complete option set and generates new option IDs.
